title: HMD brings AI companionship to a basic flip phone, complete with a recurring subscription
description: HMD has introduced a new version of its 2660 Flip with an AI companion designed to combat loneliness among elderly users. The AI can remember previous conversations, tell stories, and even play games, but continued companionship comes with a monthly subscription fee after a five-hour free trial.

title: Trump posts AI video of himself taming tiger after fatal UK zoo mauling
description: President Donald Trump posted an AI-generated video depicting himself taming a tiger after the fatal mauling of a man in England, sparking criticism.

title: York firm launches AI tool to help track at-risk staff and respond to emergencies
description: Vismo launches Vismo AI at GSX 2026 in Atlanta, helping security teams protect employees, track risks and manage emergencies with real-time data worldwide.

title: Bulgaria and US Sign Declaration on Artificial Intelligence Cooperation
description: Bulgarian Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy, Investments, and Industry Alexander Pulev discussed security, defense cooperation, and expanding economic ties in high-tech sectors with US State Department officials during a visit to Washington, where he also signed a joint declaration on cooperation in artificial intelligence. Pulev met with Fleet White, US Deputy Assistant Secretary of State for Political-Military Affairs, and Jacob Helberg, US Deputy Under Secretary of State for Economic Growth, Energy, and the Environment. The talks covered opportunities to strengthen cooperation in security, the defense industry, artificial intelligence, space technologies, and strategic investments. ...
